verdict.rationale: Pulley documents its own e-signing that collects board member and investor signatures without a third-party tool, at least for SAFEs. It also claims board management within its compliance product and attaches uploaded documents to specific securities, which loosely covers archiving. However, nothing shows board consents or stockholder approvals being drafted from templates or explicitly linked to the transactions they authorize. Missing for 10: board consent/stockholder approval drafting templates, explicit routing of consents (beyond SAFE signatures), archiving of approvals against authorized transactions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
